The man on the right wears fox ears and a green patterned leafy shirt, maintaining a neutral expression while looking at the lens. The background features a cartoonish city street facade with bright, flat colors. (2) The scene cuts to a solo shot of the man in fox ears. He is framed in a medium shot, looking directly into the camera while adjusting his fox ears with his right hand. To his left, a stylized traffic light with a red glowing signal is visible. The background buildings are painted in warm yellow and orange tones, mimicking an animation set. (3) The man in bunny ears suddenly jumps in from behind the man in fox ears, wrapping his arms around his shoulders in a cheerful hug. Both characters are now smiling and laughing, displaying high energy and positive facial expressions. The camera is steady, capturing their mid-torso to head as they interact closely against the colorful set. (4) In the final phase, the two pose together for a series of playful expressions. The man in bunny ears makes a small heart shape with his fingers against the other's cheek. They both look into the camera with squinted, happy eyes. The lighting remains consistent and bright, emphasizing the vibrant colors of their costumes and the detailed, stylized background.
